meta.promptText: Indian winters mein dry skin ke liye konsa moisturizer kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
Indian winters mein dry skin ke liye aise moisturizers best hote hain jo skin barrier ko repair karein aur lambe samay tak moisture lock karein. Aise products mein **ceramides**, **hyaluronic acid**, ya **shea butter** jaise ingredients hone chahiye.

Yahan kuch top options diye gaye hain jo winter dryness ke liye behtareen hain:

Yeh cream dry se lekar very dry skin ke liye ek **dermatologist-recommended barrier repair cream** hai. Isme **3 essential ceramides aur hyaluronic acid** hain jo skin ki dry and flaky surface ko deep hydration dete hain.

Agar aapki skin dry hone ke sath-sath sensitive bhi hai, toh yeh **fragrance-free aur non-greasy formula** skin par bahut gentle rehta hai. Yeh **glycerin aur sweet almond oil** ke sath aati hai jo skin ko lambe samay tak soft banaye rakhti hai.

Yeh budget-friendly option **dry aur itchy skin** ke liye ek acha choice hai. Yeh skin par ek **protective layer** banakar moisture ko lose hone se rokta hai.

Yeh cream **Japanese rice water aur ceramides** se enrich hai, jo winter me dry aur dull skin ko plump aur healthy look deti hai.
